title: Academic Paper Deconstruction: Abstract Writing, Literature Review & Citation Registers
objective: Menyusun ringkasan penelitian akademik, meninjau literatur, dan mengutip bukti secara ilmiah.

theory.summary: Penulisan akademik memerlukan register bahasa yang formal dan objektif. Abstract adalah ringkasan penelitian yang padat (150-250 kata) mencakup tujuan, metode, hasil, dan kesimpulan. Literature review mensintesis penelitian terdahulu untuk membangun konteks. Dalam penulisan akademik, gunakan hedging language untuk menunjukkan kehati-hatian ilmiah: 'suggests' bukan 'proves', 'appears to' bukan 'is', 'indicates' bukan 'shows definitively'. Citation menggunakan format standar (APA, Harvard, MLA) untuk memberikan credit dan memungkinkan pembaca melacak sumber. Hindari bahasa emosional atau absolut; gunakan passive voice dan nominalisasi untuk objektivitas.
rules: Hedging verbs: suggest, indicate, appear to, seem to, tend to | Contoh: 'The data suggests a correlation' bukan 'The data proves'
Reporting verbs dengan nuansa: argue, claim, assert (kuat) vs propose, suggest, imply (lemah) | Contoh: 'Smith (2024) argues that...' vs 'The findings suggest that...'
Abstract structure: Background + Aim + Method + Results + Conclusion | Contoh: 'This study investigates... Using a mixed-method approach... The results indicate... These findings suggest...'
In-text citation: (Author, Year) atau Author (Year) states... | Contoh: 'Recent research (Johnson, 2025) indicates...' atau 'Johnson (2025) found that...'
Nominalisasi untuk formalitas: 'The implementation of the policy' bukan 'When we implemented the policy' | Contoh: 'The analysis revealed...' bukan 'We analyzed and found...'

commonTrap.explanation: Mahasiswa sering menggunakan bahasa terlalu absolut dalam penulisan akademik, yang tidak mencerminkan kehati-hatian ilmiah. Pernyataan definitif tanpa hedging terdengar tidak profesional dan mengabaikan kemungkinan interpretasi alternatif.
commonTrap.wrong: This research proves that social media causes depression in teenagers.
commonTrap.correct: This research suggests that social media use may be associated with depressive symptoms in adolescents.

dialogue.context: Dr. Martinez dan seorang mahasiswa PhD, Sarah, sedang mendiskusikan draft abstract untuk paper Sarah yang akan disubmit ke konferensi internasional.

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Sarah, I've reviewed your abstract. The structure is solid, but your language is too definitive. For instance, you wrote 'this proves that AI improves learning outcomes.'
lines.translation: Sarah, saya sudah meninjau abstract kamu. Strukturnya bagus, tapi bahasanya terlalu pasti. Misalnya, kamu menulis 'ini membuktikan bahwa AI meningkatkan hasil belajar.'

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Oh, I see. Should I use hedging language instead? Maybe 'the findings suggest that AI may enhance learning outcomes'?
lines.translation: Oh, saya mengerti. Sebaiknya saya gunakan bahasa hedging ya? Mungkin 'temuan menunjukkan bahwa AI mungkin meningkatkan hasil belajar'?

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Exactly. Also, your literature review needs more synthesis. Right now, you're just listing what each author said. Try connecting the studies thematically.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Juga, literature review kamu perlu lebih banyak sintesis. Sekarang kamu hanya mencantumkan apa yang dikatakan setiap penulis. Coba hubungkan studi-studi tersebut secara tematik.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: So instead of 'Johnson found X, then Smith found Y,' I should write something like 'Recent studies converge on the view that...' and cite multiple sources?
lines.translation: Jadi daripada 'Johnson menemukan X, lalu Smith menemukan Y,' saya harus menulis seperti 'Studi-studi terkini konvergen pada pandangan bahwa...' dan mengutip beberapa sumber?

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Perfect. That demonstrates critical analysis, not just summarization. One more thing: check your citation format. You're mixing APA and Harvard styles.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Itu menunjukkan analisis kritis, bukan hanya ringkasan. Satu hal lagi: periksa format kutipan kamu. Kamu mencampur gaya APA dan Harvard.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right, I didn't notice that. I'll standardize everything to APA 7th edition. Should I also add more recent sources from 2025 and 2026?
lines.translation: Benar, saya tidak menyadarinya. Saya akan standarisasi semuanya ke APA edisi ke-7. Apakah saya juga perlu menambah sumber lebih baru dari 2025 dan 2026?

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Absolutely. It shows your research is current. Aim for at least 60% of your references from the last three years for a study in this rapidly evolving field.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Itu menunjukkan riset kamu mutakhir. Usahakan minimal 60% referensi kamu dari tiga tahun terakhir untuk studi di bidang yang berkembang pesat ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Got it. I'll revise the abstract with more hedging, synthesize the literature review, fix the citations, and update my references. Thank you, Dr. Martinez.
lines.translation: Mengerti. Saya akan revisi abstract dengan lebih banyak hedging, sintesis literature review, perbaiki kutipan, dan perbarui referensi. Terima kasih, Dr. Martinez.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul membantu Anda berlatih menyusun bagian-bagian dari academic paper. Dia akan memberikan skenario penelitian, dan Anda diminta merespons dengan bahasa akademik yang tepat, termasuk hedging dan citation.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice academic writing skills. Imagine you conducted a study on remote work productivity. Your data shows a 23% increase in output. How would you state this finding using appropriate hedging language?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The data suggests that remote work arrangements may be associated with increased productivity, with participants demonstrating approximately 23% higher output compared to the control group.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent hedging with 'suggests' and 'may be associated with.' Now, let's work on citation. How would you reference a study by Dr. Chen published in 2024 that supports your finding? Use in-text citation format.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: These findings align with previous research indicating that flexible work environments can enhance employee performance (Chen, 2024).

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect integration. Now for your literature review, you need to synthesize three studies: Roberts (2023) found remote work reduces stress, Liu (2024) found it increases autonomy, and Chen (2024) found it improves productivity. Can you synthesize these rather than just listing them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Recent literature converges on the positive outcomes of remote work arrangements, with studies highlighting reduced workplace stress (Roberts, 2023), enhanced employee autonomy (Liu, 2024), and improved productivity metrics (Chen, 2024).

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirol
turns.text: Brilliant synthesis! One final challenge: write a one-sentence abstract opener that states your research aim using appropriate academic register and nominalization.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: This investigation examines the relationship between remote work implementation and employee productivity in the technology sector during the post-pandemic period.

quiz.question:
Which sentence demonstrates appropriate hedging language for academic writing?
A research team found a link between sleep and memory performance.
options: This study proves that sleep deprivation destroys memory function.
The findings suggest that inadequate sleep may negatively impact memory performance.
Sleep definitely causes memory problems in all participants.
quiz.answer: The findings suggest that inadequate sleep may negatively impact memory performance.
quiz.explanation: Opsi ini menggunakan hedging yang tepat dengan 'suggest' dan 'may', menunjukkan kehati-hatian ilmiah. Pilihan lain terlalu absolut dengan 'proves', 'destroys', dan 'definitely' yang tidak sesuai dengan register akademik formal.

quiz.question:
Select the correct way to synthesize multiple sources in a literature review:
You need to discuss three studies about online learning effectiveness.
options: Smith (2023) said online learning is good. Then, Jones (2024) said it's effective. Also, Brown (2025) found positive results.
Numerous studies demonstrate that online learning sucks and traditional is better.
Emerging research indicates converging evidence for the effectiveness of online learning modalities (Smith, 2023; Jones, 2024; Brown, 2025).
quiz.answer: Emerging research indicates converging evidence for the effectiveness of online learning modalities (Smith, 2023; Jones, 2024; Brown, 2025).
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah sintesis yang benar karena menggabungkan beberapa sumber dalam satu pernyataan tematik dengan kutipan yang tepat. Opsi pertama hanya daftar kronologis tanpa sintesis, dan opsi kedua menggunakan bahasa tidak formal dan bias.

quiz.question:
Which abstract structure follows the correct academic format?
You're writing an abstract for an experimental study.
options: Background: Climate change is a problem. Aim: To study it. Method: We did research. Results: We found stuff. Conclusion: It's important.

This study investigates the impact of urban green spaces on air quality. Using sensor data from 15 cities over 12 months, the analysis reveals a 31% reduction in particulate matter. These findings suggest significant implications for urban planning policy.
I think green spaces are really amazing and everyone should have them because they make cities beautiful and people happy.
quiz.answer: This study investigates the impact of urban green spaces on air quality. Using sensor data from 15 cities over 12 months, the analysis reveals a 31% reduction in particulate matter. These findings suggest significant implications for urban planning policy.
quiz.explanation: Abstract ini mengikuti struktur standar: aim (investigates), method (sensor data dari 15 kota), results (31% reduction), dan conclusion (implications). Menggunakan bahasa formal, objektif, dan hedging yang tepat dengan 'suggest'.

quiz.question:
Identify the appropriate reporting verb for a strong, confident claim by a researcher:
Dr. Taylor makes a definitive statement about causation in her paper.
options: Dr. Taylor (2025) hints that there might possibly be some kind of relationship.
Dr. Taylor (2025) argues that the intervention directly caused the observed behavioral changes.
Dr. Taylor (2025) thinks maybe it could be related.
quiz.answer: Dr. Taylor (2025) argues that the intervention directly caused the observed behavioral changes.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'argues' cocok untuk klaim yang kuat dan percaya diri. Opsi lain terlalu lemah ('hints', 'possibly', 'thinks maybe') yang tidak sesuai jika peneliti membuat pernyataan definitif tentang kausalitas.

quiz.question:
Which sentence correctly uses nominalization for academic formality?
You need to describe the process of implementing a new teaching method.
options: When we implemented the new method, students performed better and we were happy with the results.
The implementation of the new pedagogical approach resulted in enhanced student performance outcomes.
We did the new teaching thing and kids did good on their tests so it worked great.
quiz.answer: The implementation of the new pedagogical approach resulted in enhanced student performance outcomes.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan nominalisasi ('implementation', 'approach', 'outcomes') yang membuat tulisan lebih formal dan objektif. Menghindari kata ganti orang pertama dan bahasa kasual. Opsi lain terlalu personal atau informal untuk penulisan akademik.
